mapper.select: select f.feedback_id, f.visitor_uid, f.record_id, f.plant_id, p.plant_name, f.feedback_type, f.feedback_reason, f.extra_note, f.create_time from zx_feedback_record f left join zx_plant p on f.plant_id = p.plant_id where f.feedback_id = #{feedbackId}
mapper.insert: insert into zx_feedback_record (visitor_uid, record_id, plant_id, feedback_type, feedback_reason, extra_note, create_time) values (#{visitorUid}, #{recordId}, #{plantId}, #{feedbackType}, #{feedbackReason}, #{extraNote}, sysdate())
